task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Set the white bell with black bottom on the electronicscale with flat rectangular base after grabbing it with the right arm.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，右臂抓住电子秤后进入框架，将黑底白底的铃铛放置在扁平矩形底座的电子秤上。
